Sreedev Rajendran

Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) · Visual Creator · Founder

Kerala, IndiaProvidence College of EngineeringFDE Focustopviewframes

I am an ongoing B.Tech student in Computer Science Engineering, specializing in Artificial Intelligence at Providence College of Engineering, Chengannur. Driven by a primary goal to become a successful entrepreneur, I am passionate about crafting and shipping innovative AI-native solutions.

Rather than a generic developer profile, I operate as a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) — working on the front lines to take advanced AI models (multimodal OCR, RAG agents, real-time context) and deploy them directly into high-impact, production applications. Through AI-assisted "vibe coding" and strong engineering architecture, I bridge the gap between frontier AI research and deployed user products that solve real problems.

I am the Founder of Topviewframes, a professional photography and videography company where I merge my technical background with visual storytelling. Outside of work and academics, I am like-minded toward travelling and exploring new places to gather fresh perspectives.
